lede: Before you grind hundreds of practice questions, get the map. A live planning session to break down the rounds you'll actually face, the mental models each one tests, where you're weakest, and exactly how to spend your prep time. This is strategy, not a mock.

faq.q: How is this different from a mock interview?
faq.a: A mock is live practice on one round. This session is the plan around all of them — what to prep, in what order, and where to spend your limited time. Many people book this first, then book mocks to execute the plan.

faq.q: Do you know specific companies' interview loops?
faq.a: I'll work from what's known about your target companies' PM loops and from patterns across the industry, then tailor the plan to your level and timeline.

faq.q: I have interviews in two weeks — is it too late?
faq.a: No — that's exactly when a focused plan matters most. We'll ruthlessly prioritise what moves the needle in the time you have.

faq.q: Should I book mocks as well?
faq.a: Usually yes. The strategy session tells you which rounds to drill; the mock and round-specific sessions are where you practice them.

finalCta.title: Stop prepping blind.
finalCta.sub: Book a strategy session and walk away knowing exactly how to spend your prep time.
